Meta’s New AI Agent Puts Spotlight On Cloudflare
No direct company catalyst was behind the stock move. It comes as
Meta Platforms Inc.
) unveiled
Muse

, a personal AI agent designed to handle real-world tasks such as booking travel, sending emails and completing purchases on a user’s behalf. Muse runs on a dedicated virtual machine and uses a built-in monitoring system, Sentinel, to approve internet-based actions, Meta said.
Cloudflare and Meta have been partners since September 2023, when Llama 2 was launched on Cloudflare Workers AI. This partnership gave developers access to privacy-focused AI models.
With Meta now pushing deeper into agentic AI through Muse, investors could be watching whether Cloudflare’s edge infrastructure could see increased demand tied to the expanding partnership.
